```{r load_libraries, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpointdensity)
library(ggpubr)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

library(stringr)
library(pROC)
library(ROCR)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)

theme_set(theme_classic())

result_dir = "~/research/data/TCR/TCGA/_results"
# cancer reactive T cell data
CAT_dir  = "~/research/CAT/data"
```

# Read in data

## Read in cell information of Zheng et al. data
```{r message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
cd8 = fread(file.path(CAT_dir, "CD8_with_NN_predictions.tsv.gz"))
cd4 = fread(file.path(CAT_dir, "CD4_with_NN_predictions.tsv.gz"))

dim(cd8)
cd8[1:2,]

dim(cd4)
cd4[1:2,]

table(cd4$label, cd4$`True Label`)
table(cd8$label, cd8$`True Label`)

table(cd8$label, cd8$Prediction > 0.5)
table(cd4$label, cd4$Prediction > 0.5)

```


# Load TCR-somatic mutation association results

```{r}
res_A = fread(file.path(result_dir, "TCR_alpha_mut_asso_rd_x_with_ct.tsv"))
dim(res_A)
res_A[1:2,]

res_B = fread(file.path(result_dir, "TCR_beta_mut_asso_rd_x_with_ct.tsv"))
dim(res_B)
res_B[1:2,]

summary(res_A$pval_LRT)
summary(res_B$pval_LRT)

wA1 = which(names(res_A) == "overlap_grp") + 1
wB1 = which(names(res_B) == "overlap_grp") + 1

p_ct_max_A = apply(res_A[,wA1:ncol(res_A)], 1, max)
p_ct_max_B = apply(res_B[,wB1:ncol(res_B)], 1, max)

res_A = res_A[which(p_ct_max_A <= 10*res_A$pval_LRT),]
dim(res_A)

res_B = res_B[which(p_ct_max_B <= 10*res_B$pval_LRT),]
dim(res_B)

table(res_A$pval_LRT <= 0.1)
table(res_B$pval_LRT <= 0.1)

res_A = res_A[pval_LRT <= 0.1,]
res_B = res_B[pval_LRT <= 0.1,]
dim(res_A)
dim(res_B)
```

# Check the postive and negative cancer reactive TCR scores

## CD8+ T cells

```{r fig.width=3, fig.height=3}
table(cd8$label == cd8$`True Label`)
cd8[, label := factor(label)]

ggplot(cd8, aes(x = label, y = Prediction)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, fill = "lightblue", color = "black") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white", outlier.shape = NA) +
  labs(
    x = "Label",
    y = "Prediction",
    title = "Prediction vs Label"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

table(cd8$label, cd8$clone_number_total > 2)

table(cd8$clone_n_patient)
table(cd8$label, cd8$clone_n_patient)

```

### The number of clones vs. cancer reactive status

```{r fig.width=6, fig.height=4}

# Build working DT
dt <- data.table(
  label = cd8$label,
  prediction = cd8$Prediction,
  clone_number_total = cd8$clone_number_total
)

table(dt$label, dt$prediction > 0.5)
table(dt$label, dt$prediction > 0.8)
table(dt$label, dt$prediction > 0.95)
table(dt$label, dt$prediction > 0.99)

# Define new_label
dt[, new_label := fifelse(as.character(label) == "1" & prediction > 0.5, "1", "0")]

# Keep only positive clone_number_total for log10
dt <- dt[clone_number_total > 0]
dt[, log_clone_total := log10(clone_number_total)]

# Combine into one long table with 4 groups
dt_label <- dt[, .(group = paste0("Label: ", as.character(label)),
                   log_clone_total)]
dt_newlabel <- dt[, .(group = paste0("New label: ", new_label),
                      log_clone_total)]

plot_dt <- rbind(dt_label, dt_newlabel)
plot_dt[, group := factor(group,
                          levels = c("Label: 0", "Label: 1",
                                     "New label: 0", "New label: 1"))]

# Draw density curves
ggplot(plot_dt, aes(x = log_clone_total, color = group, fill = group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(
    x = expression(log[10](clone_number_total)),
    y = "Density",
    color = "Group",
    fill = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```

## The number of clones vs. cancer reactive status

Barplot

```{r fig.width=6, fig.height=3}
dt <- data.table(
  clone = cd8$clone, 
  label = cd8$label,
  prediction = cd8$Prediction,
  clone_number_total = cd8$clone_number_total
)

dim(dt)

dt[, new_label := fifelse(as.character(label) == "1" & prediction > 0.5, "1", "0")]

tapply(dt$clone_number_total, dt$new_label, summary)

bins <- c("3–5", "6–10", "11–20", "21–50", "51–100", "> 100")
dt_f <- dt[clone_number_total >= 3L][
  , cn_tot_cat := cut(
      clone_number_total,
      breaks = c(3, 6, 11, 21, 51, 101, Inf),  
      right  = FALSE,
      labels = bins
    )
][, cn_tot_cat := factor(cn_tot_cat, levels = bins)]

# 2) Count per (new_label, bin), fill missing combos with 0
grid <- CJ(new_label = unique(dt_f$new_label), cn_tot_cat = factor(bins, levels = bins))
dt_counts <- merge(grid, dt_f[, .N, by = .(new_label, cn_tot_cat)], all.x = TRUE)
dt_counts[is.na(N), N := 0L]

dt_props <- copy(dt_counts)[, prop := N / sum(N), by = new_label]

p_props <- ggplot(dt_props, aes(x = cn_tot_cat, y = prop, fill = factor(new_label))) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.65) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Number of clones", y = "Proportion", fill = "Cancer reactive") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

p_props
```

### Add TCR association results

```{r}
names(cd8)
names(cd8)[1] = "cell_study_id"

cd8 = cd8[,c(1, 3:16,33,34,37:42, 46, 47)]
dim(cd8)

cd8[,TCR_asso_mutation := "neither"]

table(cd8$TRA_cdr3 %in% res_A$TCR, cd8$TRB_cdr3 %in% res_B$TCR)

cd8[TRA_cdr3 %in% res_A$TCR & TRB_cdr3 %in% res_B$TCR, 
    TCR_asso_mutation:="both"]

cd8[TRA_cdr3 %in% res_A$TCR & (! TRB_cdr3 %in% res_B$TCR), 
    TCR_asso_mutation:="alpha"]

cd8[(! TRA_cdr3 %in% res_A$TCR) & TRB_cdr3 %in% res_B$TCR, 
    TCR_asso_mutation:="beta"]

tt1 = table(cd8$TCR_asso_mutation, cd8$label == 1 & cd8$Prediction > 0.5)

```

### Plot CR proportions

```{r fig.width=3, fig.height=2.5}
df1 = data.frame(tt1)
names(df1)[1:2] = c("TCR", "CR")

df_prop <- df1 %>%
  group_by(TCR) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(Freq)) %>%
  mutate(prop_TRUE = Freq / total) 

df_prop$TCR <- factor(df_prop$TCR,
                      levels = c("neither", "alpha", "beta", "both"))
df_prop

ggplot(df_prop[df_prop$CR == TRUE,], aes(x = TCR, y = prop_TRUE, fill = TCR)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Matching of TCR chains",
       y = "Proportion of CR") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")

# Row-wise summation (log10 scale)
df_sum <- df1 %>%
  group_by(TCR) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(Freq), .groups = "drop")

df_sum$TCR <- factor(df_sum$TCR,
                     levels = c("neither", "alpha", "beta", "both"))

ggplot(df_sum, aes(x = TCR, y = total, fill = TCR)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::comma(total)),
            vjust = -0.3, size = 4) +
  scale_y_log10(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(x = "Matching of TCR chains",
       y = "Total Count (log10)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")

```

```{r fig.width=3, fig.height=3}
dt <- as.data.table(cd8)

# Treat NA as a category
dt[, TCR_asso_mutation_cat := as.character(TCR_asso_mutation)]
dt[is.na(TCR_asso_mutation_cat), TCR_asso_mutation_cat := "neither"]
dt[, TCR_asso_mutation_cat := factor(TCR_asso_mutation_cat,
                                     levels = c("neither", "alpha", "beta", "both"))]

# Define comparisons: any group vs "both"
groups <- setdiff(levels(dt$TCR_asso_mutation_cat), "both")
comparisons <- lapply(groups, function(g) c(g, "both"))

y_max <- max(dt$pos_score_CD8, na.rm = TRUE)

# Boxplot with p-values
ggplot(dt, aes(x = TCR_asso_mutation_cat, y = pos_score_CD8, fill = TCR_asso_mutation_cat)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 16, outlier.size = 1.5) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = comparisons, method = "wilcox.test") +
  labs(
    x = "Matching of TCR chains",
    y = "CD8+ T pos. CR score"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(min(dt$pos_score_CD8, na.rm = TRUE), y_max + 2.5)) + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")

y_max <- max(dt$neg_score_CD8, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(dt, aes(x = TCR_asso_mutation_cat, y = neg_score_CD8, fill = TCR_asso_mutation_cat)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 16, outlier.size = 1.5) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = comparisons, method = "wilcox.test") +
  labs(
    x = "Matching of TCR chains",
    y = "CD8+ T neg. CR score"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(min(dt$neg_score_CD8, na.rm = TRUE), y_max + 2.5)) + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")

```

## check relation with total number of clones

```{r fig.width=4.5, fig.height=3}
dt <- as.data.table(cd8)

summary(dt$clone_number_total)
# 1) Bin clone_number_total into 3–5, 6–10, 11–20, >20
dt[, cn_tot_cat := fcase(
  clone_number_total >= 3  & clone_number_total <= 5,   "3-5",
  clone_number_total >= 6  & clone_number_total <= 10,  "6-10",
  clone_number_total >= 11 & clone_number_total <= 20,  "11-20",
  clone_number_total >= 21 & clone_number_total <= 50,  "21-50",
  clone_number_total > 50,                              ">50",
  default = NA_character_
)]

# Keep only defined bins
dt <- dt[!is.na(cn_tot_cat)]

# 2) TCR_cat: include NA as a category
dt[, TCR_cat := as.character(TCR_asso_mutation)]
dt[is.na(TCR_cat), TCR_cat := "neither"]

# Set factor levels for consistent ordering
tcr_levels <- c("alpha", "beta", "both", "neither")
dt[, TCR_cat := factor(TCR_cat, levels = tcr_levels[tcr_levels %in% unique(TCR_cat)])]
cn_levels <- c("3-5", "6-10", "11-20", "21-50", ">50")
dt[, cn_tot_cat := factor(cn_tot_cat, levels = cn_levels)]

# 3) Count and compute relative frequency within each TCR_cat
freq <- dt[, .N, by = .(TCR_cat, cn_tot_cat)][
  , prop := N / sum(N), by = TCR_cat]

# Ensure all combinations exist (so missing ones are 0%)
all_combos <- CJ(TCR_cat = levels(dt$TCR_cat), cn_tot_cat = cn_levels, unique = TRUE)
freq <- merge(all_combos, freq, by = c("TCR_cat", "cn_tot_cat"), all.x = TRUE)
freq[is.na(N), `:=`(N = 0, prop = 0)]

freq[, cn_tot_cat := factor(cn_tot_cat, levels = cn_levels)]

# 4) Side-by-side bar plot
ggplot(freq, aes(x = TCR_cat, y = prop, fill = cn_tot_cat)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.7) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  labs(
    x = "TCR-mutation association",
    y = "Relative freq",
    fill = "# of clones",
    title = "CD8+ T"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

```
